model.description:
Model (maps to 30013 content `model`). Optional for backward compat
(ADR-0005 P2.2 content-map).

program.description:

tools.name: create_agent_identity

tools.description: Resolve an agent name to npub + profile fields (fail-fast on unknown).

agent_name.description:
The identity to look up: a REGISTERED adjective+noun pin, canonical
name, folded alias, or npub. bd-pin-public-plane-s-easy.8: `name` is
accepted as a serde alias (grok/other wrappers pass `name`); the
field stays REQUIRED (both missing fails — never defaults to $USER
or a generated pin).

tools.name: whois

tools.description: Resolve a herdr pane_id to the agent name (G9).
tools.name: resolve_pane_identity

tools.description: Prune identities whose herdr panes are absent from the live pane list.
tools.name: cleanup_pane_identities

ReleasedGhostOut.description:
One exclusive lease revoked because its holder pin was pruned
(bd-gc7k: a dead pin must not own the ledger).

tools.description: List a project's agents with npub + last-active provenance.
tools.name: list_agents

WhoIsOut.description:
`whois`: `{name, npub, program, model, task_description, last_active_ts_us,
stale, pane_id, workspace_id, tab_id}`.

ADR-0010 F2: `stale` flags roster rows older than the prune cadence —
never a silent live pin.

bd-u4e2: `pane_id`/`workspace_id`/`tab_id` are the LIVE herdr pane the pin
runs in (advisory; all `None` when no herdr backend is reachable). Additive
optionals — pre-u4e2 clients parse rows unchanged.

tools.description: Send a NIP-17 gift-wrapped message to one or more recipients. REQUIRED: project_key, sender_name (your adjective+noun pin), to[], subject, body_md. Shell available? Prefer: flywheel mail send <proj> --to <names> --subject S --body B.

corr.description: ADR-0027 E2: correlation id rides extra_tags corr.

reservation_id.description: When set, this call is a `request_release` (CLI compose; no new tool).

reservation_note.description: Optional note on the request-release rumor.

result_path.description: ADR-0027 E2: result_path rides extra_tags result_path.

tools.name: send_message

tools.description: Reply to a message within its thread (NIP-10 reply reference). REQUIRED: project_key, sender_name (your adjective+noun pin), to[], subject, body_md. Thread context comes from args (thread_id) - no auto-parent resolution on toron; the flywheel facade resolves it.

request_message_id.description: When set, this call is a `respond_request_release` (CLI compose).

reservation_note.description: Optional note on the response rumor.

tools.name: reply_message

tools.description: Project the agent's inbox (rumor-time order, G7). unread_only is accepted but a no-op (no read-state filter); ack_overdue_only keeps ack-required high/urgent posts past the 30m SLA the recipient has not read. Use since_ts / thread_id to scope.

ack_overdue_only.description:
Implemented: keeps ack-required high/urgent posts older than the
30m ack SLA that this recipient has not read. Same rule as the
ack-sla scan, applied post-projection.

thread_id.description: Keep only messages in this thread (bd-harvest-thread-filter-yp9r).

unread_only.description:
Accepted but a no-op (schema only): the projection carries no read
state, so every fetch returns all matching rows. Scope with since_ts.

tools.name: fetch_inbox

duplicate_of.description:
S5 (bd-dup-assign-collapse-ws21): the first id of the duplicate group
this row survives for; `null` = standalone message.

read_ts_us.description:
Read receipt timestamp (i64-µs) from the `message_reads` projection;
`null` = unread (bd-5icg).

verdict.description: HumanDecision live producer: `verdict=` extra_tag on the rumor.

tools.description: Acknowledge a message (private NIP-17 ack, idempotent).

message_id.description:
toron message id = the rumor's content-addressed hex EventId (NOT an
AM-style integer sequence). The arg is a string to match toron's own
id model — `fetch_inbox` returns `id` as hex; this accepts it verbatim.
(known-divergences §1: id-type differs by design per ADR-0003.)

tools.name: acknowledge_message

tools.description: Mark a message read (private NIP-17 read receipt, idempotent).

message_id.description: See [`AcknowledgeMessageArgs::message_id`] — hex event id, not an int.

tools.name: mark_message_read

status.description: pending | approved | denied — social graph state, not a delivery gate.

tools.description: List an agent's contact links (AgentLink rows). Link status is the social graph (pending|approved|denied) — it does NOT gate mail. Delivery is gated by the RECIPIENT's contact policy (kind-30014, see set_contact_policy, default auto): a pending link still receives mail unless the recipient's policy blocks it.

need the holder's event id.
